title: Shared controls & grid states
intro: Steel palette · compact rectangular controls · one interaction language.
geometryHint: 32px form controls, 28px compact actions and rows, 3px control corners. 12px text; tabular figures.
surfacesHint: Opaque cards; stronger field borders; quieter row dividers. Muted headers and totals anchor the grid.
interactionHint: Blue focus stays visible over selection. Hover uses the same surface in both themes. Badges retain semantic colour.
collectionHint: Visual sample only. Business dates and collection dates remain separate; Collected by and Served by remain separate. Search behavior is not simulated.
scopeHint: ACR-DEMO · overridden fields are blank and disabled
grid: Real grid · compact and stacked content
gridHint: Sort a header, open a filter, select a checkbox, then click a cell: focus and selection coexist. Drag across text to copy it. Totals describe all sample rows, before column filtering.
emptyHint: No collections match. Adjust the criteria and search again.
fieldsHint: Hover, Tab and Shift+Tab through these controls and the grid. Correct the amount to clear its error.
invalidHint: Enter a valid amount of zero or more.
commandsHint: Visual samples only. Command families and status meanings remain unchanged.
